summary: Escalate incident case-003 for s.demir@aegean.edu. VPN appliance vpn-edge-01 (firmware 22.7R2.3) is listed in CISA KEV with CVEs including CVE-2026-104935, CVE-2025-22457, and CVE-2025-0282 (F1). The sign-in path touches an exposed asset; VPN session ordering data-quality failed; compromise signals lack a confirmed abuse chain. Verdict: escalate, confidence 0.5.

risk.rationale: F1 confirms a CISA KEV-listed VPN edge appliance (vpn-edge-01, firmware 22.7R2.2/22.7R2.3) with T1133 (External Remote Services) and T1190 (Exploit Public-Facing Application) — this is an exposure requiring human review, not a confirmed account takeover chain (so not contain). The KEV signals are not explained away (not benign), and the finding exceeds a weak unexplained signal (not monitor). Supporting escalation: confidence is 0.49 (below 0.5, i.e., insufficient) and there is a data-quality conflict (DQ vpn_session_order failing for appliance:vpn-edge-01), i.e., conflicting/insufficient evidence needing a human.
